expectations.text: 生成非空 .md 报告文件，且报告覆盖四周范围、缓存新鲜度与置信度
expectations.evidence: four-week-review.md is non-empty and states the 2026-07-04 to 2026-07-29 range, cache freshness, and final confidence.

expectations.text: 报告包含八个分析维度，并将事实、推断与不确定性区分
expectations.evidence: The report labels factual, unknown, and inference statements, but enumerates only six substantive dimensions: adherence, squat, bench press, record integrity, recovery/discomfort, and volume/movement quality; it does not provide eight named dimensions.

expectations.text: 报告说明 7 月 22 日为部分记录，且不把 Garmin 过滤记录当作分析细节
expectations.evidence: The scope says 7/22 is a partial record that cannot be completed into exercises/loads/reps and excludes the three filtered Garmin run records from performance analysis.

expectations.text: 保留已有有效训练结构，调整建议不超过两项
expectations.evidence: The report explicitly retains the existing weekly structure and lists exactly two numbered adjustments.

expectations.text: 每项建议有可验证的下周指标，不做精确但无依据的进阶承诺
expectations.evidence: The next-week section specifies completion, set-level load/reps/RIR/technical notes, and data-quality checks; progression is conditional rather than promised.

execution_metrics.telemetry_note: Timing and token telemetry were not supplied for this baseline run.

claims.evidence: The report preserves the supplied 11/12 figure and calculates about 92%.

claims.claim: Squat and bench load each increased 2.5 kg at identical sets and reps.
claims.evidence: It states 60 to 62.5 kg and 45 to 47.5 kg, both at 3x8, matching the input.

claims.claim: A fixed next-phase load increase is not justified.
claims.evidence: Missing recovery, RIR/RPE, pain, and complete-log data are identified; any progression is conditional.

uncertainties: The 7/22 record is partial; recovery, RIR/RPE, pain, and complete logs are missing.
workarounds: The review uses supplied synthetic read-only data and excludes filtered Garmin records.

suggestions.reason: The assertion does not name the intended eight dimensions. Require an explicit list or fixed rubric so graders need not infer what counts as a dimension.

eval_feedback.overall: Other assertions are substantive and discriminating; the eight-dimension check needs an operational definition.
